paite: Huan chiamtehna sagihna a phel laiin dakkal kimkhat khawng van tuh a dai sipsipa.
english: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

paite: Huan Pathian maa angel sagih dingte tuh ka muta a, huan amau kiangah pengkul sagih piakin a omta a.
english: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

paite: Huan angel dang khat a hong pai a, gim namtui halna dangkaeng bel tawiin, maitam kiangah a dingta a, huan a kiangah gim namtui tampi, laltutphah maa om dangkaeng maitam tenga misiangthou tengteng thumna toh hel dingin, piakin a oma.
english: Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.

paite: Huan huai gim namtui khu leh mi siangthoute thumna tuh angel khut akipan Pathian maah a jam kheta a.
english: The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel’s hand.

paite: Huan angelin gim namtui halna dangkaeng bel a la a; huai tuh maitama meiin a hihdima, huan leitungah a paikheta a: huan van gingte leh khophia te leh jinlingte a hongomta hi.
english: The angel took the censer, and he filled it with the fire of the altar, and threw it on the earth. There followed thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake.

paite: Huan angel sagih pengkul sagih tawite mut dingin a kisata uhi.
english: The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

paite: Huan a masapenin a mutta a, gial leh mei sisan toh kihel a hongomta a, huaite tuh leitunga paihkhiakin a omta a; huan leitung mun thuma khen mun khat a kang beita a, huan sing mun thuma khen mun khat a kang beita a; huan, loupa hing tengteng a kang beita hi.
english: The first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. One third of the earth was burnt up, TR omits “One third of the earth was burnt up” and one third of the trees were burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.

paite: Huan angel nihnain a mutta a, huan tang lianpi hileh kilawm meia kanglai tuipa ah paih khiakin a om ta a;
english: The second angel sounded, and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea. One third of the sea became blood,

paite: Huan tuipi min thuam khen mun khat tuh sisan a hongsuakta a; huan huai tuipia ganhingte, hiai hina neite nngei tuh mun thuma khen mun khat a sita uh; huan long min thuma khen mun khat hihsiatin a omta hi.
english: and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. One third of the ships were destroyed.

paite: Huan angel thumnain a mutta a, huan vana kipanin aksi lianpi, meisel banga kuangin a kete a, huan lui mun thuma khen mun khat leh tui tuikhukte a delhta a.
english: The third angel sounded, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and it fell on one third of the rivers, and on the springs of the waters.

paite: Huan huai aksi min tuh Gamsai ahi; huan tui mun thumakhen mun khat gamsai a hongsuakta a; huan mi tampi huai tuitein a sita ua, amau tuh hihkhata a om jiak un.
english: The name of the star is called “Wormwood.” One third of the waters became wormwood. Many people died from the waters, because they were made bitter.

paite: Huan angel linain a mutta a, huan ni mun thuma khen mun khat leh kha mun thuma khen mun khat leh aksi mun thuma khen mu khat hihsiat a hita; huchiin avaknata uh mun thuma khen mun khat hihmialin a omtaa; sun tuh mun thuma khen mun khat vaksak louhin a omtaa, jan leng huchi mah bangin.Huan ka et leh, mupi van laijawla lengin, aw ngaihtakin, Angel thum pengkul mut lai dingte, huai ging hongom lai dingte jiakin, leitunga omte tung a gik, a gik, a gik; a chih ka zata hi.
english: The fourth angel sounded, and one third of the sun was struck, and one third of the moon, and one third of the stars; so that one third of them would be darkened, and the day wouldn’t shine for one third of it, and the night in the same way.

paite: Huan ka et leh, mupi van laijawla lengin, aw ngaihtakin, Angel thum pengkul mut lai dingte, huai ging hongom lai dingte jiakin, leitunga omte tung a gik, a gik, a gik; a chih ka zata hi.
english: I saw, and I heard an eagle, TR reads “angel” instead of “eagle” flying in mid heaven, saying with a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe for those who dwell on the earth, because of the other voices of the trumpets of the three angels, who are yet to sound!”
